<script>
(function () {
  
  
  
  
  var connected = false;
  function setLive(on) { document.querySelectorAll('.topbar .live:not(#ix-live)').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }
  if (!window.EventSource) { setLive(false); return; }
  var pill = document.getElementById('live-pill');
  var toast = document.getElementById('live-toast');
  
  
  
  
  var orbs = document.querySelectorAll('a.brand .dot');
  function setOrb(on) { orbs.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('on', on); o.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }

  var n = 0;            
  var pending = false;  
  var busy = false;     
  var again = false;    
  var debounce = null;
  var toastTimer = null;
  var toastHold = 0;    

  function fieldFocused() { var a = document.activeElement; return !!(a && a.matches && a.matches('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=""], [contenteditable="true"]')); }
  function selecting() { var s = window.getSelection && window.getSelection(); return !!(s && s.type === 'Range' && String(s).trim()); }
  function paneOpen() { return !!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split.detail-open'); }
  function cmdkOpen() { var c = document.getElementById('cmdk'); return !!(c && !c.hidden); }
  
  function safe() { return !document.hidden && !fieldFocused() && !selecting() && !paneOpen() && !cmdkOpen(); }

  function showPill() { if (!pill) return; pill.textContent = n + ' update' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' · tap to refresh'; pill.hidden = false; }
  function hidePill() { if (pill) pill.hidden = true; }
  function flashToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = msg; toast.hidden = false;
    toast.classList.remove('error');
    toast.classList.remove('show'); void toast.offsetWidth; toast.classList.add('show'); 
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function () { toast.hidden = true; }, 300); }, 2600);
  }
  
  
  
  function eventToast(msg) { flashToast(msg); toastHold = Date.now() + 2600; }
  
  
  
  
  function actionToastUp() { return !!(toast && !toast.hidden && toast.classList.contains('show') && toast.textContent !== 'Updated'); }

  function apply() {
    if (busy) { again = true; return; }
    busy = true;
    
    
    var headers = { 'X-Seam-Live': '1' };
    if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.heldViews(headers);
    fetch(location.href, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: headers })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        if (!doc.querySelector('.sidebar')) {
          
          location.assign('/console/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search));
          return;
        }
        if (!window.SeamConsole || !window.SeamConsole.patchPage(doc, 'live')) throw new Error('invalid console document');
        setLive(connected); 
        n = 0; pending = false; hidePill();
        if (Date.now() >= toastHold && !actionToastUp()) flashToast('Updated');
        
        
        setTimeout(function () {
          document.querySelectorAll('.live-in, nav.nav .count.bump').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('live-in', 'bump'); });
        }, 600);
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        
        
        if (window.SeamConsole && window.SeamConsole.stale(error)) { again = true; return; }
        pending = true; showPill(); 
      })
      .finally(function () { busy = false; if (again) { again = false; schedule(); } });
  }
  function trigger() { if (safe()) apply(); else { pending = true; showPill(); } }
  function schedule() { if (debounce) clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = setTimeout(trigger, 700); } 

  var es = new EventSource('/console/events');
  es.onopen = function () { connected = true; setOrb(true); setLive(true); };
  es.onmessage = function (ev) {
    
    
    
    
    try {
      var d = JSON.parse(ev.data), k = d.kind;
      
      
      
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:event', { detail: d }));
      if ((k === 'tool.call' || k === 'hook.prompt') && !window.SEAM_LIVE_ALL_KINDS) return;
      
      
      if (k === 'memory.first_reuse' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
      
      
      
      if (k === 'update.available' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
    } catch (e) {}
    
    
    
    if (window.SEAM_NO_LIVE_REFRESH) return;
    n++; schedule();
  };
  es.onerror = function () { connected = false; setOrb(false); setLive(false); };

  
  
  setInterval(function () { if (pending && !busy && safe()) apply(); }, 1500);
  if (pill) pill.onclick = function () { apply(); };
})();
(function () {
  

  if (document.querySelector('.list-detail-split')) return;
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    if (!row) return;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button, form')) return; 
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });
})();
(function () {
  

  
  
  
  if (!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split') || !document.getElementById('detail-pane')) return;
  function split() { return document.querySelector('.list-detail-split'); }
  function pane() { return document.getElementById('detail-pane'); }
  function pbody() { var p = pane(); return p ? p.querySelector('.detail-pane-body') : null; }
  var lastTrigger = null; 
  var pushed = false;     

  function peekURL(href) { return href + (href.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'peek=1'; }
  function targetHref(el) {
    if (el.getAttribute('href')) return el.getAttribute('href');
    var h = el.closest('[data-href]');
    return h ? h.getAttribute('data-href') : null;
  }
  function mark(href) {
    var s = split();
    if (!s) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link.selected').forEach(function (r) {
      r.classList.remove('selected'); r.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    if (!href) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link[data-href]').forEach(function (r) {
      if (r.getAttribute('data-href') === href) { r.classList.add('selected'); r.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); }
    });
  }
  function load(href) {
    return fetch(peekURL(href)).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status);
      return r.text();
    }).then(function (html) {
      var b = pbody(), p = pane(), s = split();
      if (!b || !p || !s) return;
      b.innerHTML = html;
      if (window.IX) window.IX.enhance(b);
      var openLink = p.querySelector('.detail-open');
      if (openLink) openLink.setAttribute('href', href);
      p.hidden = false;
      s.classList.add('detail-open');
      b.scrollTop = 0;
    }).catch(function () {
      if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.flash('Could not update the detail view. The current data is unchanged.', 'error');
    });
  }
  function teardown() {
    var p = pane(), s = split(), b = pbody();
    if (p) p.hidden = true;
    if (s) s.classList.remove('detail-open');
    if (b) b.innerHTML = '';
    mark(null);
    pushed = false;
    if (lastTrigger && typeof lastTrigger.focus === 'function') { try { lastTrigger.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
    lastTrigger = null;
  }
  
  
  
  function open(href, drill) {
    if (!href) return;
    var wasHidden = pane().hidden;
    load(href);
    mark(href);
    var hash = '#peek=' + encodeURIComponent(href);
    try {
      if (wasHidden) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); pushed = true; }
      else if (drill) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
      else { history.replaceState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  
  
  function requestClose() {
    if (pushed) { history.back(); return; }
    if (location.hash.indexOf('#peek=') === 0) {
      try { history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search); } catch (e) {}
    }
    teardown();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var closeHit = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.detail-close') : null;
    if (closeHit) { e.preventDefault(); requestClose(); return; }
    var peek = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-peek]') : null;
    if (peek) {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return; 
      if (e.target.closest('button, form')) return;                       
      var plainLink = e.target.closest('a[href]');
      if (plainLink && !plainLink.hasAttribute('data-peek')) return;      
      var href = targetHref(peek);
      if (!href) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      lastTrigger = e.target.closest('a[href]') || peek;
      open(href, !!e.target.closest('#detail-pane'));
      return;
    }
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    var s = split();
    if (!row || !s || !s.contains(row)) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button')) return;
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { var p = pane(); if (e.key === 'Escape' && p && !p.hidden) requestClose(); });
  
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
    var mm = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
    if (mm) { var hp = decodeURIComponent(mm[1]); pushed = true; load(hp); mark(hp); }
    else { var p = pane(); if (p && !p.hidden) teardown(); }
  });
  
  
  var m = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    try { var h0 = decodeURIComponent(m[1]); pushed = false; load(h0); mark(h0); } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var osDark = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') : null;
  
  
  function choice() {
    var t = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    return t === 'dark' || t === 'light' ? t : 'system';
  }
  function effective() {
    var c = choice();
    if (c !== 'system') return c;
    return osDark && osDark.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }
  
  
  
  function label() {
    if (!btn) return;
    var next = effective() === 'dark' ? 'Light theme' : 'Dark theme';
    if (choice() === 'system') next += effective() === 'dark' ? ' instead of the system\u2019s dark' : ' instead of the system\u2019s light';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', next);
    btn.setAttribute('title', next);
  }
  label();
  function announce() {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:theme', { detail: { theme: choice(), effective: effective() } }));
  }
  
  
  
  function set(theme) {
    if (theme === 'system') {
      root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
      try { localStorage.removeItem('seamless-theme'); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (theme === 'dark' || theme === 'light') {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      try { localStorage.setItem('seamless-theme', theme); } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      return;
    }
    label();
    announce();
  }
  window.SeamTheme = { set: set, choice: choice, effective: effective };
  if (btn) btn.onclick = function () { set(effective() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'); };
  
  
  if (osDark) {
    var onOS = function () { if (choice() === 'system') { label(); announce(); } };
    if (osDark.addEventListener) osDark.addEventListener('change', onOS);
    else if (osDark.addListener) osDark.addListener(onOS);
  }
})();
(function () {
  

  function flash(btn) {
    btn.classList.add('copied');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copied');
    setTimeout(function () {
      btn.classList.remove('copied');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy');
    }, 1100);
  }
  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.top = '-1000px';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.copy-btn[data-copy]') : null;
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { flash(btn); }, function () { fallbackCopy(text); flash(btn); });
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text);
      flash(btn);
    }
  });
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
(function () {
  
  
  
  
  var connected = false;
  function setLive(on) { document.querySelectorAll('.topbar .live:not(#ix-live)').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }
  if (!window.EventSource) { setLive(false); return; }
  var pill = document.getElementById('live-pill');
  var toast = document.getElementById('live-toast');
  
  
  
  
  var orbs = document.querySelectorAll('a.brand .dot');
  function setOrb(on) { orbs.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('on', on); o.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }

  var n = 0;            
  var pending = false;  
  var busy = false;     
  var again = false;    
  var debounce = null;
  var toastTimer = null;
  var toastHold = 0;    

  function fieldFocused() { var a = document.activeElement; return !!(a && a.matches && a.matches('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=""], [contenteditable="true"]')); }
  function selecting() { var s = window.getSelection && window.getSelection(); return !!(s && s.type === 'Range' && String(s).trim()); }
  function paneOpen() { return !!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split.detail-open'); }
  function cmdkOpen() { var c = document.getElementById('cmdk'); return !!(c && !c.hidden); }
  
  function safe() { return !document.hidden && !fieldFocused() && !selecting() && !paneOpen() && !cmdkOpen(); }

  function showPill() { if (!pill) return; pill.textContent = n + ' update' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' · tap to refresh'; pill.hidden = false; }
  function hidePill() { if (pill) pill.hidden = true; }
  function flashToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = msg; toast.hidden = false;
    toast.classList.remove('error');
    toast.classList.remove('show'); void toast.offsetWidth; toast.classList.add('show'); 
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function () { toast.hidden = true; }, 300); }, 2600);
  }
  
  
  
  function eventToast(msg) { flashToast(msg); toastHold = Date.now() + 2600; }
  
  
  
  
  function actionToastUp() { return !!(toast && !toast.hidden && toast.classList.contains('show') && toast.textContent !== 'Updated'); }

  function apply() {
    if (busy) { again = true; return; }
    busy = true;
    
    
    var headers = { 'X-Seam-Live': '1' };
    if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.heldViews(headers);
    fetch(location.href, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: headers })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        if (!doc.querySelector('.sidebar')) {
          
          location.assign('/console/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search));
          return;
        }
        if (!window.SeamConsole || !window.SeamConsole.patchPage(doc, 'live')) throw new Error('invalid console document');
        setLive(connected); 
        n = 0; pending = false; hidePill();
        if (Date.now() >= toastHold && !actionToastUp()) flashToast('Updated');
        
        
        setTimeout(function () {
          document.querySelectorAll('.live-in, nav.nav .count.bump').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('live-in', 'bump'); });
        }, 600);
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        
        
        if (window.SeamConsole && window.SeamConsole.stale(error)) { again = true; return; }
        pending = true; showPill(); 
      })
      .finally(function () { busy = false; if (again) { again = false; schedule(); } });
  }
  function trigger() { if (safe()) apply(); else { pending = true; showPill(); } }
  function schedule() { if (debounce) clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = setTimeout(trigger, 700); } 

  var es = new EventSource('/console/events');
  es.onopen = function () { connected = true; setOrb(true); setLive(true); };
  es.onmessage = function (ev) {
    
    
    
    
    try {
      var d = JSON.parse(ev.data), k = d.kind;
      
      
      
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:event', { detail: d }));
      if ((k === 'tool.call' || k === 'hook.prompt') && !window.SEAM_LIVE_ALL_KINDS) return;
      
      
      if (k === 'memory.first_reuse' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
      
      
      
      if (k === 'update.available' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
    } catch (e) {}
    
    
    
    if (window.SEAM_NO_LIVE_REFRESH) return;
    n++; schedule();
  };
  es.onerror = function () { connected = false; setOrb(false); setLive(false); };

  
  
  setInterval(function () { if (pending && !busy && safe()) apply(); }, 1500);
  if (pill) pill.onclick = function () { apply(); };
})();
(function () {
  

  if (document.querySelector('.list-detail-split')) return;
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    if (!row) return;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button, form')) return; 
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });
})();
(function () {
  

  
  
  
  if (!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split') || !document.getElementById('detail-pane')) return;
  function split() { return document.querySelector('.list-detail-split'); }
  function pane() { return document.getElementById('detail-pane'); }
  function pbody() { var p = pane(); return p ? p.querySelector('.detail-pane-body') : null; }
  var lastTrigger = null; 
  var pushed = false;     

  function peekURL(href) { return href + (href.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'peek=1'; }
  function targetHref(el) {
    if (el.getAttribute('href')) return el.getAttribute('href');
    var h = el.closest('[data-href]');
    return h ? h.getAttribute('data-href') : null;
  }
  function mark(href) {
    var s = split();
    if (!s) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link.selected').forEach(function (r) {
      r.classList.remove('selected'); r.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    if (!href) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link[data-href]').forEach(function (r) {
      if (r.getAttribute('data-href') === href) { r.classList.add('selected'); r.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); }
    });
  }
  function load(href) {
    return fetch(peekURL(href)).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status);
      return r.text();
    }).then(function (html) {
      var b = pbody(), p = pane(), s = split();
      if (!b || !p || !s) return;
      b.innerHTML = html;
      if (window.IX) window.IX.enhance(b);
      var openLink = p.querySelector('.detail-open');
      if (openLink) openLink.setAttribute('href', href);
      p.hidden = false;
      s.classList.add('detail-open');
      b.scrollTop = 0;
    }).catch(function () {
      if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.flash('Could not update the detail view. The current data is unchanged.', 'error');
    });
  }
  function teardown() {
    var p = pane(), s = split(), b = pbody();
    if (p) p.hidden = true;
    if (s) s.classList.remove('detail-open');
    if (b) b.innerHTML = '';
    mark(null);
    pushed = false;
    if (lastTrigger && typeof lastTrigger.focus === 'function') { try { lastTrigger.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
    lastTrigger = null;
  }
  
  
  
  function open(href, drill) {
    if (!href) return;
    var wasHidden = pane().hidden;
    load(href);
    mark(href);
    var hash = '#peek=' + encodeURIComponent(href);
    try {
      if (wasHidden) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); pushed = true; }
      else if (drill) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
      else { history.replaceState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  
  
  function requestClose() {
    if (pushed) { history.back(); return; }
    if (location.hash.indexOf('#peek=') === 0) {
      try { history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search); } catch (e) {}
    }
    teardown();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var closeHit = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.detail-close') : null;
    if (closeHit) { e.preventDefault(); requestClose(); return; }
    var peek = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-peek]') : null;
    if (peek) {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return; 
      if (e.target.closest('button, form')) return;                       
      var plainLink = e.target.closest('a[href]');
      if (plainLink && !plainLink.hasAttribute('data-peek')) return;      
      var href = targetHref(peek);
      if (!href) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      lastTrigger = e.target.closest('a[href]') || peek;
      open(href, !!e.target.closest('#detail-pane'));
      return;
    }
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    var s = split();
    if (!row || !s || !s.contains(row)) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button')) return;
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { var p = pane(); if (e.key === 'Escape' && p && !p.hidden) requestClose(); });
  
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
    var mm = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
    if (mm) { var hp = decodeURIComponent(mm[1]); pushed = true; load(hp); mark(hp); }
    else { var p = pane(); if (p && !p.hidden) teardown(); }
  });
  
  
  var m = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    try { var h0 = decodeURIComponent(m[1]); pushed = false; load(h0); mark(h0); } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var osDark = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') : null;
  
  
  function choice() {
    var t = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    return t === 'dark' || t === 'light' ? t : 'system';
  }
  function effective() {
    var c = choice();
    if (c !== 'system') return c;
    return osDark && osDark.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }
  
  
  
  function label() {
    if (!btn) return;
    var next = effective() === 'dark' ? 'Light theme' : 'Dark theme';
    if (choice() === 'system') next += effective() === 'dark' ? ' instead of the system\u2019s dark' : ' instead of the system\u2019s light';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', next);
    btn.setAttribute('title', next);
  }
  label();
  function announce() {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:theme', { detail: { theme: choice(), effective: effective() } }));
  }
  
  
  
  function set(theme) {
    if (theme === 'system') {
      root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
      try { localStorage.removeItem('seamless-theme'); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (theme === 'dark' || theme === 'light') {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      try { localStorage.setItem('seamless-theme', theme); } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      return;
    }
    label();
    announce();
  }
  window.SeamTheme = { set: set, choice: choice, effective: effective };
  if (btn) btn.onclick = function () { set(effective() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'); };
  
  
  if (osDark) {
    var onOS = function () { if (choice() === 'system') { label(); announce(); } };
    if (osDark.addEventListener) osDark.addEventListener('change', onOS);
    else if (osDark.addListener) osDark.addListener(onOS);
  }
})();
(function () {
  

  function flash(btn) {
    btn.classList.add('copied');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copied');
    setTimeout(function () {
      btn.classList.remove('copied');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy');
    }, 1100);
  }
  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.top = '-1000px';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.copy-btn[data-copy]') : null;
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { flash(btn); }, function () { fallbackCopy(text); flash(btn); });
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text);
      flash(btn);
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  

  function parts() {
    var rail = document.querySelector('[data-attn-rail]');
    if (!rail) return null;
    var sec = rail.closest('.ov2-attn');
    return {
      rail: rail,
      nav: sec && sec.querySelector('.ov2-attn-nav'),
      prev: sec && sec.querySelector('[data-attn-prev]'),
      next: sec && sec.querySelector('[data-attn-next]')
    };
  }
  function sync() {
    var p = parts();
    if (!p || !p.nav) return;
    var overflow = p.rail.scrollWidth - p.rail.clientWidth > 4;
    p.nav.hidden = !overflow;
    if (!overflow) return;
    if (p.prev) p.prev.disabled = p.rail.scrollLeft <= 2;
    if (p.next) p.next.disabled = p.rail.scrollLeft >= p.rail.scrollWidth - p.rail.clientWidth - 2;
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-attn-prev], [data-attn-next]');
    if (!btn) return;
    var p = parts();
    if (!p) return;
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    var dir = btn.hasAttribute('data-attn-next') ? 1 : -1;
    p.rail.scrollBy({ left: dir * Math.max(p.rail.clientWidth * 0.9, 200), behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
  });
   
  document.addEventListener('scroll', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.nodeType === 1 && e.target.hasAttribute('data-attn-rail')) sync();
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('resize', sync);
  window.addEventListener('load', sync);
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', sync);
  sync();
})();
</script>

      <h2>Isolation <span class="h2-meta">open</span></h2>
      
      <form class="iso-form" method="post" action="/console/projects/example-open-alpha/isolation">
        <div class="seg iso-seg">
          <button type="submit" name="state" value="open" class="on" aria-pressed="true">Open</button><button type="submit" name="state" value="confidential" class="" aria-pressed="false">Confidential</button><button type="submit" name="state" value="sealed" class="" aria-pressed="false">Sealed</button>
        </div>
      </form>
      <ul class="iso-promises">
        <li class="on">Open — shares normally. Global knowledge flows in; family surfaces may include it.</li><li class="">Confidential — nothing leaves. Agents in other projects never see this project&#39;s knowledge, and agents here cannot write outside it.</li><li class="">Sealed — nothing in or out. Agents here see only this project: no global memories, no family, no cross-project reads.</li>
      </ul>

<script src="/console/static/interactions.js"></script>
<script src="/console/static/search.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  
  
  
  
  var connected = false;
  function setLive(on) { document.querySelectorAll('.topbar .live:not(#ix-live)').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }
  if (!window.EventSource) { setLive(false); return; }
  var pill = document.getElementById('live-pill');
  var toast = document.getElementById('live-toast');
  
  
  
  
  var orbs = document.querySelectorAll('a.brand .dot');
  function setOrb(on) { orbs.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('on', on); o.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }

  var n = 0;            
  var pending = false;  
  var busy = false;     
  var again = false;    
  var debounce = null;
  var toastTimer = null;
  var toastHold = 0;    

  function fieldFocused() { var a = document.activeElement; return !!(a && a.matches && a.matches('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=""], [contenteditable="true"]')); }
  function selecting() { var s = window.getSelection && window.getSelection(); return !!(s && s.type === 'Range' && String(s).trim()); }
  function paneOpen() { return !!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split.detail-open'); }
  function cmdkOpen() { var c = document.getElementById('cmdk'); return !!(c && !c.hidden); }
  
  function safe() { return !document.hidden && !fieldFocused() && !selecting() && !paneOpen() && !cmdkOpen(); }

  function showPill() { if (!pill) return; pill.textContent = n + ' update' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' · tap to refresh'; pill.hidden = false; }
  function hidePill() { if (pill) pill.hidden = true; }
  function flashToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = msg; toast.hidden = false;
    toast.classList.remove('error');
    toast.classList.remove('show'); void toast.offsetWidth; toast.classList.add('show'); 
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function () { toast.hidden = true; }, 300); }, 2600);
  }
  
  
  
  function eventToast(msg) { flashToast(msg); toastHold = Date.now() + 2600; }
  
  
  
  
  function actionToastUp() { return !!(toast && !toast.hidden && toast.classList.contains('show') && toast.textContent !== 'Updated'); }

  function apply() {
    if (busy) { again = true; return; }
    busy = true;
    
    
    var headers = { 'X-Seam-Live': '1' };
    if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.heldViews(headers);
    fetch(location.href, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: headers })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        if (!doc.querySelector('.sidebar')) {
          
          location.assign('/console/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search));
          return;
        }
        if (!window.SeamConsole || !window.SeamConsole.patchPage(doc, 'live')) throw new Error('invalid console document');
        setLive(connected); 
        n = 0; pending = false; hidePill();
        if (Date.now() >= toastHold && !actionToastUp()) flashToast('Updated');
        
        
        setTimeout(function () {
          document.querySelectorAll('.live-in, nav.nav .count.bump').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('live-in', 'bump'); });
        }, 600);
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        
        
        if (window.SeamConsole && window.SeamConsole.stale(error)) { again = true; return; }
        pending = true; showPill(); 
      })
      .finally(function () { busy = false; if (again) { again = false; schedule(); } });
  }
  function trigger() { if (safe()) apply(); else { pending = true; showPill(); } }
  function schedule() { if (debounce) clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = setTimeout(trigger, 700); } 

  var es = new EventSource('/console/events');
  es.onopen = function () { connected = true; setOrb(true); setLive(true); };
  es.onmessage = function (ev) {
    
    
    
    
    try {
      var d = JSON.parse(ev.data), k = d.kind;
      
      
      
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:event', { detail: d }));
      if ((k === 'tool.call' || k === 'hook.prompt') && !window.SEAM_LIVE_ALL_KINDS) return;
      
      
      if (k === 'memory.first_reuse' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
      
      
      
      if (k === 'update.available' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
    } catch (e) {}
    
    
    
    if (window.SEAM_NO_LIVE_REFRESH) return;
    n++; schedule();
  };
  es.onerror = function () { connected = false; setOrb(false); setLive(false); };

  
  
  setInterval(function () { if (pending && !busy && safe()) apply(); }, 1500);
  if (pill) pill.onclick = function () { apply(); };
})();
(function () {
  

  if (document.querySelector('.list-detail-split')) return;
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    if (!row) return;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button, form')) return; 
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });
})();
(function () {
  

  
  
  
  if (!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split') || !document.getElementById('detail-pane')) return;
  function split() { return document.querySelector('.list-detail-split'); }
  function pane() { return document.getElementById('detail-pane'); }
  function pbody() { var p = pane(); return p ? p.querySelector('.detail-pane-body') : null; }
  var lastTrigger = null; 
  var pushed = false;     

  function peekURL(href) { return href + (href.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'peek=1'; }
  function targetHref(el) {
    if (el.getAttribute('href')) return el.getAttribute('href');
    var h = el.closest('[data-href]');
    return h ? h.getAttribute('data-href') : null;
  }
  function mark(href) {
    var s = split();
    if (!s) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link.selected').forEach(function (r) {
      r.classList.remove('selected'); r.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    if (!href) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link[data-href]').forEach(function (r) {
      if (r.getAttribute('data-href') === href) { r.classList.add('selected'); r.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); }
    });
  }
  function load(href) {
    return fetch(peekURL(href)).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status);
      return r.text();
    }).then(function (html) {
      var b = pbody(), p = pane(), s = split();
      if (!b || !p || !s) return;
      b.innerHTML = html;
      if (window.IX) window.IX.enhance(b);
      var openLink = p.querySelector('.detail-open');
      if (openLink) openLink.setAttribute('href', href);
      p.hidden = false;
      s.classList.add('detail-open');
      b.scrollTop = 0;
    }).catch(function () {
      if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.flash('Could not update the detail view. The current data is unchanged.', 'error');
    });
  }
  function teardown() {
    var p = pane(), s = split(), b = pbody();
    if (p) p.hidden = true;
    if (s) s.classList.remove('detail-open');
    if (b) b.innerHTML = '';
    mark(null);
    pushed = false;
    if (lastTrigger && typeof lastTrigger.focus === 'function') { try { lastTrigger.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
    lastTrigger = null;
  }
  
  
  
  function open(href, drill) {
    if (!href) return;
    var wasHidden = pane().hidden;
    load(href);
    mark(href);
    var hash = '#peek=' + encodeURIComponent(href);
    try {
      if (wasHidden) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); pushed = true; }
      else if (drill) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
      else { history.replaceState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  
  
  function requestClose() {
    if (pushed) { history.back(); return; }
    if (location.hash.indexOf('#peek=') === 0) {
      try { history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search); } catch (e) {}
    }
    teardown();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var closeHit = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.detail-close') : null;
    if (closeHit) { e.preventDefault(); requestClose(); return; }
    var peek = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-peek]') : null;
    if (peek) {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return; 
      if (e.target.closest('button, form')) return;                       
      var plainLink = e.target.closest('a[href]');
      if (plainLink && !plainLink.hasAttribute('data-peek')) return;      
      var href = targetHref(peek);
      if (!href) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      lastTrigger = e.target.closest('a[href]') || peek;
      open(href, !!e.target.closest('#detail-pane'));
      return;
    }
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    var s = split();
    if (!row || !s || !s.contains(row)) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button')) return;
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { var p = pane(); if (e.key === 'Escape' && p && !p.hidden) requestClose(); });
  
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
    var mm = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
    if (mm) { var hp = decodeURIComponent(mm[1]); pushed = true; load(hp); mark(hp); }
    else { var p = pane(); if (p && !p.hidden) teardown(); }
  });
  
  
  var m = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    try { var h0 = decodeURIComponent(m[1]); pushed = false; load(h0); mark(h0); } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var osDark = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') : null;
  
  
  function choice() {
    var t = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    return t === 'dark' || t === 'light' ? t : 'system';
  }
  function effective() {
    var c = choice();
    if (c !== 'system') return c;
    return osDark && osDark.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }
  
  
  
  function label() {
    if (!btn) return;
    var next = effective() === 'dark' ? 'Light theme' : 'Dark theme';
    if (choice() === 'system') next += effective() === 'dark' ? ' instead of the system\u2019s dark' : ' instead of the system\u2019s light';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', next);
    btn.setAttribute('title', next);
  }
  label();
  function announce() {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:theme', { detail: { theme: choice(), effective: effective() } }));
  }
  
  
  
  function set(theme) {
    if (theme === 'system') {
      root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
      try { localStorage.removeItem('seamless-theme'); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (theme === 'dark' || theme === 'light') {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      try { localStorage.setItem('seamless-theme', theme); } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      return;
    }
    label();
    announce();
  }
  window.SeamTheme = { set: set, choice: choice, effective: effective };
  if (btn) btn.onclick = function () { set(effective() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'); };
  
  
  if (osDark) {
    var onOS = function () { if (choice() === 'system') { label(); announce(); } };
    if (osDark.addEventListener) osDark.addEventListener('change', onOS);
    else if (osDark.addListener) osDark.addListener(onOS);
  }
})();
(function () {
  

  function flash(btn) {
    btn.classList.add('copied');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copied');
    setTimeout(function () {
      btn.classList.remove('copied');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy');
    }, 1100);
  }
  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.top = '-1000px';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.copy-btn[data-copy]') : null;
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { flash(btn); }, function () { fallbackCopy(text); flash(btn); });
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text);
      flash(btn);
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  

  var bar = document.getElementById('tabs');
  if (!bar) return;
  var tabs = bar.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]');
  var panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tabpanel[data-panel]');
  function activate(key) {
    var found = false;
    panels.forEach(function (p) { var on = p.getAttribute('data-panel') === key; p.classList.toggle('on', on); if (on) found = true; });
    if (!found) return;
    tabs.forEach(function (t) { t.classList.toggle('on', t.getAttribute('data-tab') === key); });
    try { history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + '?tab=' + key); } catch (e) {}
  }
  bar.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var t = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-tab]') : null;
    if (!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    activate(t.getAttribute('data-tab'));
  });
})();

(function () {
  

  var PANEL = '.tabpanel[data-panel="tasks"]';
  function inPanel(el) { return !!(el && el.closest && el.closest(PANEL)); }
  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }

  function fill(box) {
    var src = box.getAttribute('data-dossier');
    if (!src) return;
    box.setAttribute('data-loaded', 'loading');
    var url = src + '?peek=1&next=' + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + '?tab=tasks');
    fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { Accept: 'text/html' } })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        box.classList.remove('dossier-error');
        box.innerHTML = html;
        var open = document.createElement('a');
        open.className = 'dossier-open';
        open.href = src;
        open.textContent = 'open full ↗';
        box.appendChild(open);
        box.setAttribute('data-loaded', '1');
      })
      .catch(function () {
        box.textContent = 'Could not load this task. The row is unchanged.';
        box.classList.add('dossier-error');
        box.removeAttribute('data-loaded'); 
      });
  }

  
  document.addEventListener('toggle', function (e) {
    var row = e.target;
    if (!row.matches || !row.matches('details.step') || !row.open || !inPanel(row)) return;
    var box = row.querySelector('.step-dossier');
    if (box && !box.getAttribute('data-loaded')) fill(box);
  }, true);

  
  
  
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var chip = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-jump]') : null;
    if (!chip || !inPanel(chip) || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return;
    e.preventDefault(); 
    var id = (chip.getAttribute('href') || '').replace(/^#/, '');
    var target = id ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
    if (!target) return;
    for (var p = target.parentElement; p; p = p.parentElement) {
      if (p.tagName === 'DETAILS') p.open = true;
      if (p.matches && p.matches(PANEL)) break;
    }
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    target.classList.remove('flash');
    void target.offsetWidth;
    target.classList.add('flash');
  });
  document.addEventListener('animationend', function (e) {
    if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('flash')) e.target.classList.remove('flash');
  });

  
  
  setInterval(function () {
    var now = Date.now();
    document.querySelectorAll(PANEL + ' [data-lease-exp]').forEach(function (el) {
      var exp = Date.parse(el.getAttribute('data-lease-exp'));
      var v = el.querySelector('.v');
      if (isNaN(exp) || !v) return;
      var left = Math.floor((exp - now) / 1000);
      if (left <= 0) {
        v.textContent = 'lapsed';
        el.classList.add('lease-lapsed');
        el.classList.remove('lease-warn');
        return;
      }
      if (left >= 3600) v.textContent = Math.floor(left / 3600) + 'h ' + Math.floor((left % 3600) / 60) + 'm';
      else v.textContent = Math.floor(left / 60) + ':' + pad(left % 60);
      el.classList.remove('lease-lapsed');
      el.classList.toggle('lease-warn', left < 300);
    });
  }, 1000);

  
  
  
  var stale = '';
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    var box = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.step-dossier') : null;
    if (box && inPanel(box)) stale = box.id;
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', function () {
    if (!stale) return;
    var box = document.getElementById(stale);
    stale = '';
    if (!box) return;
    box.removeAttribute('data-loaded');
    fill(box);
  });
})();

(function () {
  

  if (!window.IX) return;
  var feed = document.getElementById('ix-pfeed');
  var kinds = document.getElementById('ix-pkinds');
  window.IX.mountVolume(document.getElementById('ix-pvol'), feed, kinds);
  window.IX.wireKindFilter(kinds, feed);
})();
</script>

    <div class="card iso-card" id="isolation">
      <h2>Isolation <span class="h2-meta">confidential</span></h2>
      
      <form class="iso-form" method="post" action="/console/projects/example-confidential/isolation">
        <div class="seg iso-seg">
          <button type="submit" name="state" value="open" class="" aria-pressed="false">Open</button><button type="submit" name="state" value="confidential" class="on" aria-pressed="true">Confidential</button><button type="submit" name="state" value="sealed" class="" aria-pressed="false">Sealed</button>
        </div>
      </form>
      <ul class="iso-promises">
        <li class="">Open — shares normally. Global knowledge flows in; family surfaces may include it.</li><li class="on">Confidential — nothing leaves. Agents in other projects never see this project&#39;s knowledge, and agents here cannot write outside it.</li><li class="">Sealed — nothing in or out. Agents here see only this project: no global memories, no family, no cross-project reads.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>

<section class="feature-off" data-feature-off="screening">
  <span class="feature-off-icon"><svg class="ico ico-power" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2v10"/><path d="M18.4 6.6a9 9 0 1 1-12.77.04"/></svg></span>
  <h1>Write screening is switched off</h1>
  <p class="feature-off-blurb">Screens every agent write to memories and notes for secrets, injection markers, hidden characters, encoded blobs and unlisted links, and holds suspicious ones -- with any change to a binding rule by a session that read outside text -- out of briefings and recall until you release them. It also reviews the existing corpus on this machine, keeps files changed outside Seamless out of briefings until you accept them, and adds a lockdown switch.</p>
  <p class="feature-off-kept">Nothing was deleted. The data is preserved exactly as it was and this screen returns the moment the feature is switched back on.</p>
  <a class="btn primary" href="/console/settings?s=features"><svg class="ico ico-settings" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.22 2h-.44a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v.18a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.73l-.43.25a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 0-2.73.73l-.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 .73 2.73l.15.1a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.72v.51a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.74l-.15.09a2 2 0 0 0-.73 2.73l.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 2.73.73l.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.43.25a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.73V20a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h.44a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-.18a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.73l.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.15.08a2 2 0 0 0 2.73-.73l.22-.39a2 2 0 0 0-.73-2.73l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.74v-.5a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.74l.15-.09a2 2 0 0 0 .73-2.73l-.22-.38a2 2 0 0 0-2.73-.73l-.15.08a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.73V4a2 2 0 0 0-2-2z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg> Turn it on in Settings</a>

<script>
(function () {
  
  
  
  
  var connected = false;
  function setLive(on) { document.querySelectorAll('.topbar .live:not(#ix-live)').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }
  if (!window.EventSource) { setLive(false); return; }
  var pill = document.getElementById('live-pill');
  var toast = document.getElementById('live-toast');
  
  
  
  
  var orbs = document.querySelectorAll('a.brand .dot');
  function setOrb(on) { orbs.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('on', on); o.classList.toggle('off', !on); }); }

  var n = 0;            
  var pending = false;  
  var busy = false;     
  var again = false;    
  var debounce = null;
  var toastTimer = null;
  var toastHold = 0;    

  function fieldFocused() { var a = document.activeElement; return !!(a && a.matches && a.matches('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=""], [contenteditable="true"]')); }
  function selecting() { var s = window.getSelection && window.getSelection(); return !!(s && s.type === 'Range' && String(s).trim()); }
  function paneOpen() { return !!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split.detail-open'); }
  function cmdkOpen() { var c = document.getElementById('cmdk'); return !!(c && !c.hidden); }
  
  function safe() { return !document.hidden && !fieldFocused() && !selecting() && !paneOpen() && !cmdkOpen(); }

  function showPill() { if (!pill) return; pill.textContent = n + ' update' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' · tap to refresh'; pill.hidden = false; }
  function hidePill() { if (pill) pill.hidden = true; }
  function flashToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = msg; toast.hidden = false;
    toast.classList.remove('error');
    toast.classList.remove('show'); void toast.offsetWidth; toast.classList.add('show'); 
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function () { toast.hidden = true; }, 300); }, 2600);
  }
  
  
  
  function eventToast(msg) { flashToast(msg); toastHold = Date.now() + 2600; }
  
  
  
  
  function actionToastUp() { return !!(toast && !toast.hidden && toast.classList.contains('show') && toast.textContent !== 'Updated'); }

  function apply() {
    if (busy) { again = true; return; }
    busy = true;
    
    
    var headers = { 'X-Seam-Live': '1' };
    if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.heldViews(headers);
    fetch(location.href, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: headers })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then(function (html) {
        var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        if (!doc.querySelector('.sidebar')) {
          
          location.assign('/console/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search));
          return;
        }
        if (!window.SeamConsole || !window.SeamConsole.patchPage(doc, 'live')) throw new Error('invalid console document');
        setLive(connected); 
        n = 0; pending = false; hidePill();
        if (Date.now() >= toastHold && !actionToastUp()) flashToast('Updated');
        
        
        setTimeout(function () {
          document.querySelectorAll('.live-in, nav.nav .count.bump').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('live-in', 'bump'); });
        }, 600);
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        
        
        if (window.SeamConsole && window.SeamConsole.stale(error)) { again = true; return; }
        pending = true; showPill(); 
      })
      .finally(function () { busy = false; if (again) { again = false; schedule(); } });
  }
  function trigger() { if (safe()) apply(); else { pending = true; showPill(); } }
  function schedule() { if (debounce) clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = setTimeout(trigger, 700); } 

  var es = new EventSource('/console/events');
  es.onopen = function () { connected = true; setOrb(true); setLive(true); };
  es.onmessage = function (ev) {
    
    
    
    
    try {
      var d = JSON.parse(ev.data), k = d.kind;
      
      
      
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:event', { detail: d }));
      if ((k === 'tool.call' || k === 'hook.prompt') && !window.SEAM_LIVE_ALL_KINDS) return;
      
      
      if (k === 'memory.first_reuse' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
      
      
      
      if (k === 'update.available' && d.summary) eventToast(d.summary);
    } catch (e) {}
    
    
    
    if (window.SEAM_NO_LIVE_REFRESH) return;
    n++; schedule();
  };
  es.onerror = function () { connected = false; setOrb(false); setLive(false); };

  
  
  setInterval(function () { if (pending && !busy && safe()) apply(); }, 1500);
  if (pill) pill.onclick = function () { apply(); };
})();
(function () {
  

  if (document.querySelector('.list-detail-split')) return;
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    if (!row) return;
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button, form')) return; 
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });
})();
(function () {
  

  
  
  
  if (!document.querySelector('.list-detail-split') || !document.getElementById('detail-pane')) return;
  function split() { return document.querySelector('.list-detail-split'); }
  function pane() { return document.getElementById('detail-pane'); }
  function pbody() { var p = pane(); return p ? p.querySelector('.detail-pane-body') : null; }
  var lastTrigger = null; 
  var pushed = false;     

  function peekURL(href) { return href + (href.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'peek=1'; }
  function targetHref(el) {
    if (el.getAttribute('href')) return el.getAttribute('href');
    var h = el.closest('[data-href]');
    return h ? h.getAttribute('data-href') : null;
  }
  function mark(href) {
    var s = split();
    if (!s) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link.selected').forEach(function (r) {
      r.classList.remove('selected'); r.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    if (!href) return;
    s.querySelectorAll('.row-link[data-href]').forEach(function (r) {
      if (r.getAttribute('data-href') === href) { r.classList.add('selected'); r.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); }
    });
  }
  function load(href) {
    return fetch(peekURL(href)).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('http ' + r.status);
      return r.text();
    }).then(function (html) {
      var b = pbody(), p = pane(), s = split();
      if (!b || !p || !s) return;
      b.innerHTML = html;
      if (window.IX) window.IX.enhance(b);
      var openLink = p.querySelector('.detail-open');
      if (openLink) openLink.setAttribute('href', href);
      p.hidden = false;
      s.classList.add('detail-open');
      b.scrollTop = 0;
    }).catch(function () {
      if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.flash('Could not update the detail view. The current data is unchanged.', 'error');
    });
  }
  function teardown() {
    var p = pane(), s = split(), b = pbody();
    if (p) p.hidden = true;
    if (s) s.classList.remove('detail-open');
    if (b) b.innerHTML = '';
    mark(null);
    pushed = false;
    if (lastTrigger && typeof lastTrigger.focus === 'function') { try { lastTrigger.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
    lastTrigger = null;
  }
  
  
  
  function open(href, drill) {
    if (!href) return;
    var wasHidden = pane().hidden;
    load(href);
    mark(href);
    var hash = '#peek=' + encodeURIComponent(href);
    try {
      if (wasHidden) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); pushed = true; }
      else if (drill) { history.pushState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
      else { history.replaceState({ peek: 1 }, '', hash); }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  
  
  function requestClose() {
    if (pushed) { history.back(); return; }
    if (location.hash.indexOf('#peek=') === 0) {
      try { history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search); } catch (e) {}
    }
    teardown();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var closeHit = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.detail-close') : null;
    if (closeHit) { e.preventDefault(); requestClose(); return; }
    var peek = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-peek]') : null;
    if (peek) {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button === 1) return; 
      if (e.target.closest('button, form')) return;                       
      var plainLink = e.target.closest('a[href]');
      if (plainLink && !plainLink.hasAttribute('data-peek')) return;      
      var href = targetHref(peek);
      if (!href) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      lastTrigger = e.target.closest('a[href]') || peek;
      open(href, !!e.target.closest('#detail-pane'));
      return;
    }
    var row = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.row-link[data-href]') : null;
    var s = split();
    if (!row || !s || !s.contains(row)) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a, button')) return;
    var sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection();
    if (sel && sel.type === 'Range' && sel.toString()) return;
    location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { var p = pane(); if (e.key === 'Escape' && p && !p.hidden) requestClose(); });
  
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
    var mm = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
    if (mm) { var hp = decodeURIComponent(mm[1]); pushed = true; load(hp); mark(hp); }
    else { var p = pane(); if (p && !p.hidden) teardown(); }
  });
  
  
  var m = location.hash.match(/^#peek=(.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    try { var h0 = decodeURIComponent(m[1]); pushed = false; load(h0); mark(h0); } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var osDark = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') : null;
  
  
  function choice() {
    var t = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    return t === 'dark' || t === 'light' ? t : 'system';
  }
  function effective() {
    var c = choice();
    if (c !== 'system') return c;
    return osDark && osDark.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }
  
  
  
  function label() {
    if (!btn) return;
    var next = effective() === 'dark' ? 'Light theme' : 'Dark theme';
    if (choice() === 'system') next += effective() === 'dark' ? ' instead of the system\u2019s dark' : ' instead of the system\u2019s light';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', next);
    btn.setAttribute('title', next);
  }
  label();
  function announce() {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seam:theme', { detail: { theme: choice(), effective: effective() } }));
  }
  
  
  
  function set(theme) {
    if (theme === 'system') {
      root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
      try { localStorage.removeItem('seamless-theme'); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (theme === 'dark' || theme === 'light') {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      try { localStorage.setItem('seamless-theme', theme); } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      return;
    }
    label();
    announce();
  }
  window.SeamTheme = { set: set, choice: choice, effective: effective };
  if (btn) btn.onclick = function () { set(effective() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'); };
  
  
  if (osDark) {
    var onOS = function () { if (choice() === 'system') { label(); announce(); } };
    if (osDark.addEventListener) osDark.addEventListener('change', onOS);
    else if (osDark.addListener) osDark.addListener(onOS);
  }
})();
(function () {
  

  function flash(btn) {
    btn.classList.add('copied');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copied');
    setTimeout(function () {
      btn.classList.remove('copied');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy');
    }, 1100);
  }
  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.top = '-1000px';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.copy-btn[data-copy]') : null;
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { flash(btn); }, function () { fallbackCopy(text); flash(btn); });
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text);
      flash(btn);
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
window.SEAM_NO_LIVE_REFRESH = true; 
(function () {
  function busy(formID, btnID, label) {
    var form = document.getElementById(formID);
    if (!form || form._seamBusyWired) return;
    form._seamBusyWired = true;
    form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
      form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
      (form.closest('.gardener-request-card') || form).classList.add('is-busy');
      var btn = document.getElementById(btnID);
      if (btn) btn.textContent = label;
    });
  }
  function enhanceGardener() {
    busy('req-form', 'req-go', 'Interpreting…');
    busy('split-form', 'split-go', 'Planning…');

    var ta = document.getElementById('req-text');
    if (ta && !ta._seamWired) {
      ta._seamWired = true;
      ta.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('req-form').requestSubmit();
      });
    }
    if (ta) {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-request-example]').forEach(function (button) {
        if (button._seamWired) return;
        button._seamWired = true;
        button.addEventListener('click', function () {
          ta.value = button.getAttribute('data-request-example');
          ta.focus();
          ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        });
      });
    }

    
    
    var split = document.getElementById('split-form');
    if (split && ta && !split._seamInstructionWired) {
      split._seamInstructionWired = true;
      split.addEventListener('submit', function () {
        if (ta.value.trim() !== '') document.getElementById('split-instruction').value = ta.value;
      });
    }
  }
  enhanceGardener();
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', enhanceGardener);
})();
</script>

          <h2>Experience</h2>
          <p>How much of the console you see. A level changes what is shown here, never what your agents receive &mdash; and a screen a level hides still opens from any link.</p>

<script>
window.SEAM_NO_LIVE_REFRESH = true; 
(function () {
  
  
  var legacy = { '#features': 'features', '#briefing-recipe': 'briefing', '#workspace-registry': 'workspaces', '#semantic-index': 'engine', '#runtime-profile': 'engine' };
  if (legacy[location.hash] && !/[?&]s=/.test(location.search) && window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.load('/console/settings?s=' + legacy[location.hash], { history: 'replace', source: 'query' });
})();
(function () {
  function snapshot(form) {
    return Array.from(new FormData(form).entries()).map(function (pair) { return pair[0] + '=' + pair[1]; }).sort().join('&');
  }
  function reflectDirty(form) {
    var state = document.getElementById(form._seamStateId);
    if (!state) return;
    var dirty = snapshot(form) !== form._seamBaseline;
    form.classList.toggle('is-dirty', dirty);
    state.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = dirty ? form._seamDirtyText : form._seamCleanText;
  }
  
  function enhanceDirtyForm(selector, stateId, dirtyText) {
    var form = document.querySelector(selector);
    var state = document.getElementById(stateId);
    if (!form || !state || !window.FormData) return;
    form._seamStateId = stateId;
    form._seamDirtyText = dirtyText;
    form._seamBaseline = snapshot(form);
    form._seamCleanText = state.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent;
    if (!form._seamWired) {
      form._seamWired = true;
      form.addEventListener('input', function () { reflectDirty(form); });
      form.addEventListener('change', function () { reflectDirty(form); });
    }
    reflectDirty(form);
  }
  function updateFamilyCount(form) {
    var options = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('[data-family-option]'));
    var count = form.querySelector('[data-family-selection]');
    var optionList = form.querySelector('[data-family-options]');
    var selected = options.filter(function (option) { return option.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]').checked; }).length;
    if (count) {
      count.textContent = selected + ' selected';
      count.classList.remove('is-error');
    }
    if (optionList) optionList.classList.remove('has-error');
  }
  function enhanceFamilyForm(form) {
    if (!form._seamWired) {
      form._seamWired = true;
      form.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
        if (event.target.matches('input[type="checkbox"]')) updateFamilyCount(form);
      });
      form.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
        if (!event.target.matches('[data-family-filter]')) return;
        var query = event.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        form.querySelectorAll('[data-family-option]').forEach(function (option) {
          option.hidden = query !== '' && option.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) === -1;
        });
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
        var options = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('[data-family-option]'));
        if (options.some(function (option) { return option.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]').checked; })) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        var count = form.querySelector('[data-family-selection]');
        var optionList = form.querySelector('[data-family-options]');
        var filter = form.querySelector('[data-family-filter]');
        if (count) {
          count.textContent = 'Choose at least one project';
          count.classList.add('is-error');
        }
        if (optionList) optionList.classList.add('has-error');
        if (filter) filter.focus();
      });
    }
    updateFamilyCount(form);
  }
  function closeDialog(dialog) {
    if (typeof dialog.close === 'function') dialog.close();
    else dialog.removeAttribute('open');
  }
  function enhanceFamilies() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-family-form]').forEach(enhanceFamilyForm);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-open]').forEach(function (button) {
      if (button._seamWired) return;
      button._seamWired = true;
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var dialog = document.getElementById(button.getAttribute('data-dialog-open'));
        if (!dialog) return;
        if (typeof dialog.showModal === 'function') dialog.showModal();
        else dialog.setAttribute('open', '');
        var name = dialog.querySelector('input[name="name"]');
        if (name) name.focus();
      });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.family-dialog').forEach(function (dialog) {
      dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-close]').forEach(function (button) {
        if (button._seamWired) return;
        button._seamWired = true;
        button.addEventListener('click', function () { closeDialog(dialog); });
      });
      if (dialog._seamWired) return;
      dialog._seamWired = true;
      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        if (event.target === dialog) closeDialog(dialog);
      });
      dialog.addEventListener('close', function () {
        var form = dialog.querySelector('[data-family-form]');
        if (!form) return;
        form.reset();
        var filter = form.querySelector('[data-family-filter]');
        if (filter) {
          filter.value = '';
          filter.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }
        updateFamilyCount(form);
      });
    });
  }
  
  
  
  
  
  
  function syncThemeChoice() {
    var theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var current = theme === 'dark' || theme === 'light' ? theme : 'system';
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-choice] input[name="theme"]').forEach(function (input) {
      input.checked = input.value === current;
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
    var input = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('[data-theme-choice] input[name="theme"]') : null;
    if (input && window.SeamTheme) window.SeamTheme.set(input.value);
  });
  
  
  function revealActiveSection() {
    var chip = document.querySelector('.settings-subnav a.active');
    var nav = chip && chip.parentElement;
    if (!nav || nav.scrollWidth <= nav.clientWidth) return;
    
    
    var gap = chip.getBoundingClientRect().left - nav.getBoundingClientRect().left;
    nav.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, nav.scrollLeft + gap - (nav.clientWidth - chip.offsetWidth) / 2);
  }
  revealActiveSection();
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', revealActiveSection);
  document.addEventListener('seam:theme', syncThemeChoice);
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', syncThemeChoice);
  syncThemeChoice();
  
  
  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    var discard = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('[data-form-discard]') : null;
    if (!discard) return;
    var form = discard.closest('form');
    if (!form) return;
    form.reset();
    
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
  });
  
  
  
  function presetValues(radio) {
    try { return JSON.parse(radio.getAttribute('data-preset-values') || '{}'); } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function formMatches(form, values) {
    return Object.keys(values).every(function (name) {
      var el = form.elements[name];
      if (!el) return false;
      if (el.type === 'checkbox') return el.checked === !!values[name];
      if (el.type === 'number') return el.value !== '' && Number(el.value) === Number(values[name]);
      return el.value === String(values[name]);
    });
  }
  function syncPresets() {
    var form = document.querySelector('[data-briefing-form]');
    var picker = document.querySelector('[data-brief-presets]');
    if (!form || !picker) return;
    var any = false;
    picker.querySelectorAll('input[name="briefing-preset"]').forEach(function (radio) {
      radio.checked = formMatches(form, presetValues(radio));
      if (radio.checked) any = true;
    });
    var custom = picker.querySelector('[data-preset-custom]');
    if (custom) custom.hidden = any;
  }
  document.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
    var radio = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('input[name="briefing-preset"]') : null;
    var form = document.querySelector('[data-briefing-form]');
    if (!radio || !form) return;
    var values = presetValues(radio);
    Object.keys(values).forEach(function (name) {
      var el = form.elements[name];
      if (!el) return;
      if (el.type === 'checkbox') el.checked = !!values[name];
      else el.value = String(values[name]);
    });
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
  });
  document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
    if (event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-briefing-form]')) syncPresets();
  });
  document.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
    if (event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-briefing-form]') && event.target.name !== 'briefing-preset') syncPresets();
  });
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', syncPresets);
  
  
  
  
  var previewTimer = null;
  var previewSeq = 0;
  function refreshPreview() {
    var form = document.querySelector('[data-briefing-form]');
    var select = document.querySelector('[data-brief-preview-project]');
    var body = document.querySelector('[data-brief-preview-body]');
    if (!form || !select || !body || !window.FormData || !window.URLSearchParams) return;
    var params = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form));
    params.set('project', select.value);
    var seq = ++previewSeq;
    body.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    fetch('/console/settings/briefing/preview', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: params,
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: { Accept: 'text/html' }
    }).then(function (response) {
      
      
      return response.text();
    }).then(function (html) {
      if (seq !== previewSeq) return;
      body.innerHTML = html;
      body.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    }).catch(function () {
      if (seq !== previewSeq) return;
      body.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
      if (window.SeamConsole) window.SeamConsole.flash('Could not update the preview. Nothing was saved.', 'error');
    });
  }
  function schedulePreview() {
    if (previewTimer) clearTimeout(previewTimer);
    previewTimer = setTimeout(refreshPreview, 300);
  }
  document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
    
    
    if (event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-briefing-form]') && !event.target.closest('[data-brief-preview]')) schedulePreview();
  });
  document.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
    if (event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-brief-preview-project]')) refreshPreview();
  });
  function enhanceSettings() {
    enhanceDirtyForm('[data-briefing-form]', 'brief-state', 'Unsaved changes — save to use them for new sessions.');
    enhanceDirtyForm('[data-features-form]', 'features-state', 'Unsaved changes — save to apply them.');
    enhanceDirtyForm('[data-backups-form]', 'backups-state', 'Unsaved changes — save to use them from the next backup.');
    enhanceFamilies();
    refreshPreview();
  }
  enhanceSettings();
  document.addEventListener('seam:content-updated', enhanceSettings);
})();
</script>


  </main>
